After W_loss_coordinate_deletion_response_K, the earned object is a finite coordinate-deletion response table over U pair-support masks: V/E/C are active deletion coordinates, F is deletion-neutral, and dense/topology/downstream controls remain blocked. The operation is finite: three active-coordinate pair deletions {{V,E},{V,C},{E,C}} plus three F-containing boundary-control pairs {{V,F},{E,F},{C,F}} over the same three U support-mask rows.
